From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen

programme.title: Breathing new life into century-old Yueju Opera
programme.desc: Yueju Opera is one of the five major Chinese operas. It is skillful in narration and sentiment and is popular across China. This timeless form of intangible cultural heritage now has new apprentices. We followed a young duo of Yueju Opera performers: eleven-year-old Wang Yuhan and her stage partner, nine-year-old Huang Xinru in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, as they shared kindred spirits in inheriting the performing art of Yueju Opera.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Ad Break
programme.desc: Ad Break

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Breathing new life into century-old Yueju Opera
programme.desc: Yueju Opera is one of the five major Chinese operas. It is skillful in narration and sentiment and is popular across China. This timeless form of intangible cultural heritage now has new apprentices. We followed a young duo of Yueju Opera performers: eleven-year-old Wang Yuhan and her stage partner, nine-year-old Huang Xinru in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, as they shared kindred spirits in inheriting the performing art of Yueju Opera.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China’s largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess’s birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China’s largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess’s birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China’s largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess’s birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Ahn Ye-eun
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the multi-talented musician Ahn Ye-eun! This artist made herself known to the public in 2015 as the runner-up of the audition program K-Pop Star Season 5. During the show she amazed the public with her songwriting skills including Red Tie which she wrote after watching the film The King and the Clown. 2 years later Red Tie was featured in the soundtrack of the TV series The Rebel along with another one of her compositions Magic Lily. This past August she released her third single Trumpet Creeper which is about a court lady once loved by the king but forgotten soon. With her trademark heartrending voice she presents a beautiful harmony of pop and traditional sounds. In this episode Ahn Ye-eun performs Red Tie Trumpet Creeper KAKOTOPIA Goblin and more to showcase the quintessence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her unique music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lydia Lee
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is super-talented singer Lydia Lee! Back in 2015 one high school student posted her cover of Adele's smash single “Hello” to YouTube. The video quickly went viral worldwide garnering about 14 million views in just three weeks. It's none other than Lydia Lee. Soon after that she appeared in The Ellen DeGeneres Show as the second Korean after PSY. What's more the American magazine People also chose her rendition as the best cover of Hello. 2 years later in 2017 Lydia Lee released her debut album Blue and in August this year she returned to the music scene with the EP The House That I Live In. In this episode this artist performs Blue Don't Matter Villa Deshayes Grey to Green Farewell John and her cover of Sam Kim's Make Up. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and see once again how she mesmerizes the world!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Silica Gel
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band Silica Gel! Known for their iconic explosive energy this quartet impressed both listeners and critics with their self-titled debut album Silica Gel in 2016. Not surprisingly they swept various major rookie awards that year and quickly became new leaders of the Korean indie music scene. Back in December 2017 after the release of the EP SiO2.nH2O Silica Gel took a hiatus to complete their mendatory military duties and then returned in August this year with the much-anticipated new single KYO181. In this episode Silica Gel performs KYO181 NEO SOUL Nap and more to showcase their unchaning unpredictable energy and sound just like their name. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and take a glimpse into their experimental yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Sa-wol
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Kim Sa-wol! This artist made her big debut in 2014 as a member of the folk duo Kim Sawol x Kim Hae Won and enchanted many with the debut mini-album Secret. That year the two won the Best Rookie Artist and the Best Folk Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. The next year Kim Sa-wol released her first solo album Suzanne and then the second solo album Romance winning a total of 5 awards at the Korean Music Awards between 2014 and 2018. This past September Kim Sa-wol dropped her third release as a solo artist. Titled Heaven It illustrates her honest stories and feelings including loneliness life's uncertainty frustration and more. Her wispy voice and the bittersweet mood blend well in this new masterpiece. In this episode Kim Sa-wol performs Disposable KEY Fugitive Yellow Signal and Someone to offer an exquisite glimpse into her stunning musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her intimate dreamy music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JANNABI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are the beloved monkies of the Korean music industry - JANNABI! JANNABI is an old-fashioned Korean word for “monkey” and this band made their debut in 2014 with the digital single Rocket. Since then they have impressed numerous listeners with their retro-infused music that portrays various stories of the youth ranging from love to separation to frustration. Last year the band released their second full-length album Legend and topped all the music charts with the album's lead track for lovers who hesitate. Before releasing their third full-length album next year the band dropped a new mini-album just a week ago and this time as a duo to nourish listeners' hearts. In this episode JANNABI performs both their latest tracks and hit songs - A thought on an autumn night Old dog Sweet memories and Step from their new album JANNABI's Small Pieces 1 as well as Summer and for lovers who hesitate. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy a beautiful autumn day with these talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Bo-kyung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a top-notch vocalist and songwriter Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)! This artist first made herself known to the public in 2010 through Superstar K2 and caused a real sensation with her rendition of Kelly Clarkson's Because of You. The following year she made her official debut with the first mini-album The First Day and then took part in the soundtracks of numerous TV series and films starting with School 2013. Recently Kim Bo-kyung (Neon) dropped the new digital single Why Am I? It's her first new song in 5 months with an intense guitar riff and band sound. 5 months back she released the song Let's Walk Through The Flower Path to offer a message of comfort to listeners as we are all going through the pandemic era. In this episode this musician performs That night That day (010)Unknown Call Let's Walk Through The Flower Path Love Yourself Why Am I? and Don't Think You're Alone. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)'s kaleidoscopic musicality!

This artist made her big debut in 2014 as a member of the folk duo Kim Sawol x Kim Hae Won and enchanted many with the debut mini-album Secret. That year the two won the Best Rookie Artist and the Best Folk Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. The next year Kim Sa-wol released her first solo album Suzanne and then the second solo album Romance winning a total of 5 awards at the Korean Music Awards between 2014 and 2018. This past September Kim Sa-wol dropped her third release as a solo artist. Titled Heaven It illustrates her honest stories and feelings including loneliness life's uncertainty frustration and more. Her wispy voice and the bittersweet mood blend well in this new masterpiece. In this episode Kim Sa-wol performs Disposable KEY Fugitive Yellow Signal and Someone to offer an exquisite glimpse into her stunning musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her intimate dreamy music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JANNABI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are the beloved monkies of the Korean music industry - JANNABI! JANNABI is an old-fashioned Korean word for “monkey” and this band made their debut in 2014 with the digital single Rocket. Since then they have impressed numerous listeners with their retro-infused music that portrays various stories of the youth ranging from love to separation to frustration. Last year the band released their second full-length album Legend and topped all the music charts with the album's lead track for lovers who hesitate. Before releasing their third full-length album next year the band dropped a new mini-album just a week ago and this time as a duo to nourish listeners' hearts. In this episode JANNABI performs both their latest tracks and hit songs - A thought on an autumn night Old dog Sweet memories and Step from their new album JANNABI's Small Pieces 1 as well as Summer and for lovers who hesitate. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy a beautiful autumn day with these talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Bo-kyung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a top-notch vocalist and songwriter Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)! This artist first made herself known to the public in 2010 through Superstar K2 and caused a real sensation with her rendition of Kelly Clarkson's Because of You. The following year she made her official debut with the first mini-album The First Day and then took part in the soundtracks of numerous TV series and films starting with School 2013. Recently Kim Bo-kyung (Neon) dropped the new digital single Why Am I? It's her first new song in 5 months with an intense guitar riff and band sound. 5 months back she released the song Let's Walk Through The Flower Path to offer a message of comfort to listeners as we are all going through the pandemic era. In this episode this musician performs That night That day (010)Unknown Call Let's Walk Through The Flower Path Love Yourself Why Am I? and Don't Think You're Alone. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)'s kaleidoscopic musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Meaningful Stone
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life’s ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jukjae
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is guitarist and singer-songwriter Jukjae! This artist initially made his reputation in the music scene as a session guitarist composer and arranger. Then in April 2014 he released a self-written song View through the compilation album bright #2 and his debut album One Word in November officially starting a singing career of his own. Thanks to his dexterity in playing guitar he has played with a number of top musicians including Park Hyo-shin Kim Dong-ryul IU and more. Last month in November Jukjae released his second mini-album 2006 the year Jukjae describes as “the most beautiful and innocent time” in his life. With the lead single Shining My 2006 he hopes people will look back at the time they were at their brightest and happiest to escape reality for a brief moment. In this episode Jukjae performs Shining My 2006 The Door Do You Want To Walk With Me? Let's Go See the Stars and View. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - GB9
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented vocalist duo GB9! GB9 is composed of Gil-gu and Bong-gu who were known for their exceptional singing skills even before their debut. They sang for a number of top-notch artists as backup vocalists including Lee Juck Park Hyo-shin Kim Jo-han Taeyang Baek Z Young Gummy Lynn Kim Tae-woo and more. The two are also top vocal coaches who taught B1A4 BTOB and Oh My Girl. In 2013 the two made their official debut with the single Going Crazy and instantly captured listeners' hearts. In 2017 the duo's 2014 single I hope it's a breeze made it to the Melon Top 100 Chart and once again proved that the song is a timeless classic. From The King of Mask Singer to Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend the two took part in various music shows and impressed viewers with their artistry. Last month in November GB9 released an emotional ballad called If I knew touching listeners once more in this cold season. In this episode GB9 performs their latest single If I knew and biggest hit I hope it's a breeze among others. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their flawless performance!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Ha Hyun-sang
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Ha Hyun-sang! This artist made his big debut in February 2018 with the single Dawn. Since then he has released two mini-albums and a number of singles and also taken part in the soundtracks of top TV series such as Mr. Sunshine Melo Is My Nature A Piece of Your Mind and Soul Mechanic. Last year he participated in a talent show for indie musicians Super Band as a member of Hoppipolla and managed to finish first. Last month Ha Hyun-sang released his new single 3108 which is about a guy wanting to go back in time to correct his past mistakes. Full of heartrending sentiments this song is more than good enough to get a glimpse into his fantastic artistry. In this episode Ha Hyun-sang performs 3108 Nostalgia A Book of Love and more to show off his talents. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let this artist melt your heart!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. programme.title: HINGAQ PAGI 610
programme.desc: Hingaq Pagi ialah segmen pagi Perlis FM yang menyajikan gabungan muzik, perkongsian isu semasa, dan topik santai untuk menemani pendengar memulakan hari. Disampaikan secara mesra dan informatif, segmen ini turut menawarkan tip harian serta interaksi bersama pendengar.

programme.title: BERITA PERLISFM 8 PAGI

programme.title: HANGAT LIT 102
programme.desc: Hangat Lit merupakan segmen tengah hari Perlis FM yang bersiaran dari jam 10.00 pagi hingga 2.00 petang, menampilkan perkongsian topik semasa, trend popular, dan isu hangat terkini. programme.title: HEMOI HEMOI 26

programme.title: PELET PEGHELIH

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Dachshund, prince of the dog world and American pitbull, the gangster boss compete to see who is the cutest? There are many problems when taking your dog out for a walk, pet trainer teaches your dog to walk well in 3 steps! What are the precautions for daily care of dogs dog owners are most concerned about? Remember to deworm regularly to give them a fullout protection! Let's make a nutritious fresh pet food cake together! Tainan’s first leisure farm designed specifically for pets, keep your furry friends entertained through spring outings and play in the water!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Dogs are mans’ most loyal friends. Their well-behaved and cute appearance is very soothing to our hearts. That’s why many people choose dogs to company with their family! There are many choices for companion dogs, but today's cute pet have well-developed muscles and a fierce look on their faces. But in fact, they love to act cute, making the contrast between their personality and appearance is extremely cute! Today's Cute Pet Coming is going to subvert everyone’s impression on them! Follow us and get to know bulldogs ​​with a fierce face and gentle heart!

programme.desc: New popular pets of the dark world have all "crawled" out and gathered together?! Dark cuisines made from insects can also taste delicious?! Eye-opening! programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series. Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie. High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie. High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight. Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: This hilarious compilation features dancing dogs, talking dogs, some of the world's cleverest canines - and priceless puppy fails, all caught on camera for our serious amusement. Plus we catch up with the stars of some of the web's most popular dog videos

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house. After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected.

programme.title: Best Of Pets

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: What items should a novice cat owner prepare to welcome their cat home? Recommendation of the best breeds for beginners among all cute cats! Eat like a champion cat by following healthy recipes we reveal! Don’t be afraid if you have a destructive cat at home, a trainer will help you understand your cat’s out-of-control behavior, Angelic Cat Training Class has begin! When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd. But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on. The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation. There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!! They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.desc: A programme exploring the scientific and technological dimensions of selected Quranic verses, highlighting their relevance to modern scientific discoveries and knowledge. programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. programme.title: Warisan Kita

programme.title: Etnik Kita

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Sinister - The Gates of Hell
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: A young couple's tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

programme.title: 7ujuh
programme.desc: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.
